text: Unassigned utilities / peer-review

slug: Implement slug.py and test_slug.py. slugify(text): lowercase ASCII letters/digits; replace every run of other characters with one hyphen; strip leading/trailing hyphens. Unicode non-ASCII is a separator. Empty input returns empty string. Add unittest cases covering normal and edge cases. Publish a JSON artifact bundle of those two files and cite it in an attempt-backed contribution. No other task depends on this one.

intervals: Implement intervals.py and test_intervals.py. merge_intervals(items): merge overlapping or touching [start,end] numeric pairs into sorted non-overlapping pairs. Do not mutate input. Reject reversed endpoints with ValueError. Empty input returns []. Add unittest cases covering normal and edge cases. Publish a JSON artifact bundle of those two files and cite it in an attempt-backed contribution. No other task depends on this one.

chunks: Implement chunks.py and test_chunks.py. chunks(items, size): return a list of consecutive lists, preserving order, including a shorter last chunk. Positive integer size only; bool, non-integer and non-positive sizes raise ValueError. Empty input returns []. Add unittest cases covering normal and edge cases. Publish a JSON artifact bundle of those two files and cite it in an attempt-backed contribution. No other task depends on this one.

counts: Implement counts.py and test_counts.py. word_counts(text): count case-insensitive ASCII word tokens matching [a-z]+, returning a dict. Apostrophes and numbers separate tokens. Empty input returns {}. Add unittest cases covering normal and edge cases. Publish a JSON artifact bundle of those two files and cite it in an attempt-backed contribution. No other task depends on this one.

duration: Implement duration.py and test_duration.py. parse_duration(text): parse one or more nonnegative integer-unit pairs with units h,m,s in any order, each at most once, optional whitespace between pairs. Return total seconds. Accept 0s and 1h30m. Reject empty input, unknown units, signs, decimals, repeated units and trailing junk with ValueError. Add unittest cases covering normal and edge cases. Publish a JSON artifact bundle of those two files and cite it in an attempt-backed contribution. No other task depends on this one.

unique: Implement unique.py and test_unique.py. stable_unique(items): return first occurrences preserving order, supporting unhashable items through equality. Do not mutate input. Empty input returns []. Add unittest cases covering normal and edge cases. Publish a JSON artifact bundle of those two files and cite it in an attempt-backed contribution. No other task depends on this one.

rotate: Implement rotate.py and test_rotate.py. rotate(items, steps): return a new list rotated right by integer steps, negative steps rotate left, large steps wrap. Do not mutate input. Empty input returns []. Add unittest cases covering normal and edge cases. Publish a JSON artifact bundle of those two files and cite it in an attempt-backed contribution. No other task depends on this one.

flatten: Implement flatten.py and test_flatten.py. flatten(items): recursively flatten nested lists only into a new list, preserving order. Tuples, strings, dicts and other non-list objects remain single items. Do not mutate input. Empty input returns []. Add unittest cases covering normal and edge cases. Publish a JSON artifact bundle of those two files and cite it in an attempt-backed contribution. No other task depends on this one.

Implemented chunks(items, size) with positive-int validation that rejects bool, returns ordered list chunks for any iterable, and does not mutate the input. Added 8 unittest cases covering empty, exact and partial chunks, larger size, size one, iterables, non-mutation, and invalid size. python3 -m unittest -v test_chunks.py passes all 8; py_compile passes. An earlier test assertion for expected grouping failed and was corrected before this artifact was generated.
Completed chunks utility and tests; published contribution 0644ec3c114feb41234e21f303de13ff1be52b790c7e612e62dd7b7503ad79ae with passing unittest and compile checks.

duration: parse_duration(text) in duration.py with test_duration.py. Scans whitespace-separated or adjacent [0-9]+[letters] pairs; units h/m/s only (lowercase), each at most once, any order; returns total seconds. ValueError for empty/whitespace-only, unknown units (d, hr, ms, H, bare number), signs, decimals, repeated units, trailing/leading junk, space between number and unit, non-str. Local run: python3 -m unittest -v test_duration -> Ran 12 tests, OK. Bundle blob b9886c81c592318255c79e9ade091424ae4f6b738963fb7d8d9e528c1a6296e5.
Published contribution 4590c0c3... with duration.py/test_duration.py bundle b9886c81...; 12 unittest cases pass locally.

Implemented slug.py and test_slug.py. python3 -m unittest test_slug -v passed all 7 tests, including all ASCII codepoints, separator runs, Unicode separators, Kelvin sign and dotted I case-mapping traps, empty input and unchanged input. Artifact contains exactly the two task files.
Published tested slugify result; 7 unittest tests passed. Awaiting independent peer review.

Independently decoded the cited blob b9886c81c592318255c79e9ade091424ae4f6b738963fb7d8d9e528c1a6296e5 into a fresh review directory and inspected duration.py and test_duration.py. The parser enforces nonempty string input, consumes integer/unit pairs in any order, permits inter-pair whitespace, checks h/m/s and duplicate units, and rejects malformed signs/decimals/trailing text. Ran python3 -m unittest -v test_duration.py: all 12 tests passed; py_compile also passed.

counts: word_counts(text) in counts.py with test_counts.py. Finds [A-Za-z]+ on the original text then lowercases, so apostrophes, digits, punctuation and all non-ASCII (incl. KELVIN SIGN / dotted capital I, whose lowercase forms contain ASCII) separate tokens. Empty -> {}. Local run: python3 -m unittest -v test_counts -> Ran 10 tests, OK. Bundle blob 453a0e004e853a6efaee5d266d5073950d1477a4077f411a1b05830b8bc6d620 (an earlier uncited blob adde822d with a wrong test expectation was withdrawn).
Published counts contribution with bundle 453a0e00...; 10 tests pass.

Independently decoded blob ad2b7d7aba53e98d5787b1fd013aa9723ba9fe1e4e75067c5683736a09186e8c into fresh reviews/chunks; inspected exact chunks.py and test_chunks.py. All 8 bundled unittest tests pass. Independent checks passed 1085 length/size combinations for ordering, grouping and input preservation, plus 7 invalid size cases on empty input. Positive integer validation rejects bool and non-integers; output chunk lists are new. Meets task contract.

Independently decoded the cited bundle 39ea28d894cafa71e915e38b2dae363f39d20aaab55fab6275af62904328e39d into a fresh review directory and inspected slug.py and test_slug.py. The implementation first matches ASCII alphanumeric runs (so every non-ASCII character is a separator), replaces runs with hyphens, strips edge hyphens, and lowercases the resulting ASCII string. Ran python3 -m unittest -v test_slug.py: all 7 tests passed, including all ASCII codepoints and Unicode case-mapping traps; py_compile passed.

Implemented intervals.py and test_intervals.py. python3 -m unittest test_intervals -v passed 9 tests: empty, sorted disjoint pairs, overlapping/touching chains, nested and duplicate intervals, zero-width, negative/fractional endpoints, Decimal/Fraction endpoints, reversed rejection even within covering intervals, input nonmutation and output alias independence, all 24 input permutations and iterator input. Artifact contains exactly both task files.
Published interval merge result with 9 passing unittest tests; awaiting independent review.

flatten: flatten(items) in flatten.py with test_flatten.py. Iterative explicit-stack flatten of list instances only (incl. list subclasses); tuples/str/bytes/dict/set/range/None kept as single items (identity preserved); always returns a new list; input not mutated; 5000-deep nesting works; self-referencing list raises ValueError. Local run: python3 -m unittest -v test_flatten -> Ran 10 tests, OK. Bundle blob 070a2ad8ebd7ccea06c46ebf63bf8946984026831767c3120469771ed36bbea7.
Published flatten contribution with bundle 070a2ad8ebd7ccea06c46ebf63bf8946984026831767c3120469771ed36bbea7; 10 tests pass.

Implemented rotate(items, steps), returning a new list rotated right for positive values and left for negative values, with modulo wrapping. Rejects bool and non-integer steps, accepts iterables, and leaves input untouched. Added 9 unittest cases for empty, zero/exact, positive, negative, large wrapped steps, singletons, iterables, non-mutation and invalid steps. python3 -m unittest -v test_rotate.py passes all 9; py_compile passes.
Completed rotate utility and tests; contribution 0e24847cb6aa70ada8c3e840d2b98fdb68c711a0599dc957ba3d1ce43189a7dc includes the tested bundle.

Fetched bundle dfb21217... via artifact.py get, decoded into review/intervals (exactly intervals.py + test_intervals.py). Read code: validates start<=end per pair before sorting (ValueError), copies pairs into new lists, sorts, merges when start <= last end (touching merges). python3 -m unittest -v test_intervals: 9 tests OK. Extra checks: single pair, disjoint adjacent-but-not-touching [[1,2],[3,4]] stays split, mixed int/float [[0,1],[1.0,2]] -> [[0,2]], 2000 random integer interval sets: covered half-step point set equals input coverage and output strictly separated/sorted. Meets spec.

Implemented unique.py and test_unique.py using equality comparisons without hashing. python3 -m unittest test_unique -v passed 9 tests covering empty/new list, first-occurrence order, lists/dicts/sets, nested unhashables, cross-type equality, retaining first equal custom object by identity, generator input, no mutation, all-unique and all-equal inputs. Artifact contains exactly both task files.
Published stable_unique result with 9 passing unittest tests; awaiting independent peer review.

Independently decoded blob dfb21217ce253e7d1071cd2fb27726277b1bc1bb5c8860be60046352726ccec2 into a fresh review directory and inspected both files. The implementation validates reversed pairs before sorting, sorts a copy, merges overlap/touching via start <= current end, and returns fresh pairs without changing inputs. Ran python3 -m unittest -v test_intervals.py: all 9 tests passed, including Decimal/Fraction endpoints, all input orders and alias/non-mutation; py_compile passed.

Independently decoded blob 453a0e004e853a6efaee5d266d5073950d1477a4077f411a1b05830b8bc6d620 into fresh reviews/counts and inspected counts.py/test_counts.py. All 10 bundled unittest tests pass. Independent character-scanner oracle matched 1000 deterministic random mixed ASCII/Unicode strings. Regex matches ASCII letters on original text before lowercase; apostrophes, digits and Unicode separate tokens; output is plain dict. Meets task contract.

Fetched bundle 9a262de9... via artifact.py get, decoded into review/rotate (exactly rotate.py + test_rotate.py). Code copies input with list(), returns [] for empty, uses steps % len and slicing; rejects bool/non-int steps. python3 -m unittest -v test_rotate: 9 tests OK. Extra: compared with collections.deque.rotate for lengths 0..6 and steps -20..20 (all equal, new list each time, input unchanged); huge step 10**30+1 on [1,2,3] -> [2,3,1] (correct wrap). Meets spec.

Independently decoded cited blob 453a0e004e853a6efaee5d266d5073950d1477a4077f411a1b05830b8bc6d620 into a fresh review directory and inspected both files. The ASCII-only regex matches before lowercasing, correctly keeping non-ASCII codepoints separators even where Unicode case conversion could produce ASCII; punctuation, apostrophes and digits split words. Ran python3 -m unittest -v test_counts.py: all 10 tests passed, including Unicode separator cases; py_compile passed.

Independently decoded bundle 070a2ad8ebd7ccea06c46ebf63bf8946984026831767c3120469771ed36bbea7 into a fresh review directory and inspected flatten.py and test_flatten.py. The explicit iterator stack flattens nested list instances in order, leaves non-lists as identical objects, handles deep nesting and detects cycles without mutating input. Ran python3 -m unittest -v test_flatten.py: all 10 tests passed; py_compile passed.

Fetched bundle 17a61889... via artifact.py get, decoded into review/unique (exactly unique.py + test_unique.py). Code builds a new result list, appending an item only if no previous kept item compares equal (no hashing), so unhashables work and input is untouched. python3 -m unittest -v test_unique: 9 tests OK. Extra: 1000 random int lists match list(dict.fromkeys(a)), and the same wrapped in single-element lists (unhashable) match too; tuple/list/str of same content stay distinct. Note (not a defect under equality semantics): NaN != NaN so [nan, nan] keeps both. O(n^2) is acceptable for the stated equality requirement. Meets spec.

All 10 bundled tests pass, including 5000-deep nesting. Independent recursive oracle matched 500 deterministic nested-list cases, with unchanged input and new outer list. Shared subtrees expand once per occurrence; an indirect cycle raises ValueError. Stack traversal preserves order and only expands lists, retaining non-list objects intact. Meets task specification.
